decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly generate mana with cards like Desperate Ritual, Pyretic Ritual, and Ruby Medallion to play powerful spells and combo pieces like Grapeshot. The deck also utilizes cantrips like Manamorphose and Reckless Impulse to dig for key cards, while cards like Wrenn's Resolve and Valakut Awakening help with card advantage and deck manipulation. Ral, Monsoon Mage is used as a win condition to deal damage to the opponent, while Wish provides additional versatility in accessing sideboard cards. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces to overwhelm the opponent and win the game.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, supported by removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm. The deck also includes Ajani, Nacatl Pariah for additional creature power and Goblin Bombardment for direct damage. The inclusion of cards like Arena of Glory and Static Prison help control the board and protect your creatures, while cards like Ocelot Pride and Seasoned Pyromancer provide card advantage and token generation. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly with a mix of aggression and control elements.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and direct damage spells to overwhelm the opponent quickly. Using a mix of efficient creatures like Guide of Souls and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, along with burn spells like Galvanic Discharge, the deck aims to apply pressure early and close out games swiftly. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and game-changing enchantments like Arena of Glory further boost the deck's aggressive strategy, making it a formidable force in the Modern format.

This deck revolves around playing aggressive Eldrazi creatures quickly and disrupting opponents with Chalice of the Void and Thought-Knot Seer. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats while using various Eldrazi abilities to control the board and dictate the pace of the game. With a mixture of mana acceleration, targeted removal, and disruptive spells, this deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control throughout the match, ultimately ending the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This Boros Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures, burn spells, and disruptive enchantments. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provide powerful threats, while Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge help control the board. Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Elegant Parlor offer additional card advantage, and Static Prison slows down the opponent's game plan. With a mix of aggression, burn, and disruption, this deck aims to quickly close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

Supporting cards like Ocelot Pride and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury enhance the aggression of the deck, while cards like Arena of Glory and Thraben Charm provide additional ways to control the board. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and relentless assault.

The deck focuses on quickly developing a board presence with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, supported by powerful enchantments like Arena of Glory and Ocelot Pride. The strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creature aggression and burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment. The inclusion of cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provides additional card advantage and flexibility in different game situations. The deck focuses on quickly attacking opponents with a mix of creatures and burn spells, utilizing cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to deal damage early on. It also includes control elements like Static Prison and Thraben Charm to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and direct damage, while also providing some protection and disruption to maintain board control. The main focus of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by using a combination of hand disruption spells, removal spells, and counter spells to control the board. The deck also aims to generate card advantage through efficient card draw and filtering with cards like Preordain and Murktide Regent. The inclusion of powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Psychic Frog allows the deck to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted. The key concept of this deck is to quickly establish a board presence and apply pressure to the opponent with cheap and efficient creatures, while also disrupting their game plan with spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart. The deck aims to consistently deal damage to the opponent while also using cards like Preordain and Mishra's Bauble to dig for more threats and maintain card advantage. The inclusion of cards like Mutagenic Growth and Slickshot Show-Off allows for additional ways to pump up creatures and deal extra damage to finish off the opponent quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and aggressive creatures, supported by burn spells and efficient card draw. By utilizing low-cost spells and creatures, the deck aims to quickly deal damage to the opponent and maintain constant pressure. The inclusion of cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration also helps in maintaining card advantage and ensuring consistent draws. The deck's focus on tempo and aggression makes it a formidable force in the Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The primary focus of this deck is to assemble a powerful combo utilizing cards that do not require land resources. By efficiently using various spells and abilities, the deck aims to generate significant advantages over opponents and control the game state. With a combination of disruptive elements and powerful creatures, the deck seeks to overwhelm opponents and secure victory through clever plays and strategic maneuvering. This deck excels at generating unexpected and game-changing interactions that can catch opponents off guard and seize victory in a swift and decisive manner.

This aggressive Red Deck Wins archetype focuses on dealing damage quickly and efficiently to the opponent. The deck relies on low-cost burn spells like Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Rift Bolt, as well as efficient creatures like Chandra's Incinerator and Iridescent Vinelasher to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. The deck also includes cards like Skullcrack to prevent the opponent from gaining life and Searing Blaze to control the board. With a focus on fast damage and quick wins, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game with a combination of ramp spells and powerful Eldrazi creatures. By using cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talisman of Impulse to accelerate mana production, the deck can quickly cast threatening threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. The inclusion of removal spells like Kozilek's Command and Kozilek's Return helps control the board while Sowing Mycospawn and Writhing Chrysalis provide additional value. With a strong late-game plan and powerful Eldrazi creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents in the late game.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to play powerful Eldrazi creatures and control the board with cards like Malevolent Rumble. It also includes utility cards like Karn, the Great Creator and All Is Dust to deal with threats. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker while maintaining control over the game through disruption and large threats. The mana base is built around Eldrazi Temple and various lands to support the colorless mana requirements of the Eldrazi creatures.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption cards to disrupt the opponent's game plan. It aims to control the board with cards like Fatal Push and Murktide Regent while also utilizing card advantage engines like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The deck also includes powerful threats like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted. Its mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and provide consistency in casting its spells.
